ai_summary: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Limited (AETL) has acquired an additional 1.22% stake in its subsidiary, JC Biotech Private Limited (JCB), for ₹22.80 million, increasing its total ownership to 96.94%. This transaction is a step towards making JCB a Wholly Owned Subsidiary, with AETL actively pursuing the remaining 3.06% equity. The acquisition reflects a strategic move to consolidate control and simplify the corporate structure, with no apparent red flags.
